<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        $incoming = false;
        return [3 => "old", "flag" => true];
    }
};
$selector = "read";
echo $reader->$selector === [3 => "old", "flag" => true] ? "ARRAY;" : "BAD_ARRAY;";
$reader->drop;
echo "DROP;";
echo $selector === "read" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
